actually, it's pretty fun. not accurate to the ad I saw, which is weird, but compared to other mobile games it doesnt shove ads down your throat. In fact, it makes you want to watch ads as a way to get more gems, which is only for those impatient players like myself. a game you can play without spending money and still advance. took me by surprise how enjoyable it is. would and have recommended it to others. a "share to get more energy" button in game would be pretty smart.

This is the easiest most relaxing game ever on Tester Up, and your micro earnings becomes substantial as you play, If you need a peaceful and quiet diversion, this is the game app for you, Bingo voyage, the graphics are ultra class and it doesn't squeeze you into buying in-app. They just let you play then pay you for your moment of enjoyment and they also induce temporary amnesia that you forget all your worries as you play. I can't wait to share this game to my Mom...Hi Mom! 😅
